name: Power Platform ADR
description: Describe a delivery decision and it writes an Architecture Decision Record choosing between Agent Builder, Copilot Studio, a Power Apps code app or a combination: decision drivers, architecturally significant requirements, every option scored against documented Microsoft facts, the chosen option with its consequences and a confirmation step, in MADR v4 form. HVE Core's ADR Creator, scoped to Power Platform.
author: Arindam Choudhury
